title: Generalizing Identifiability Results in Causal Discovery from Complete Data to Missing Data Settings
abstract: arXiv:2610.19211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While causal discovery methods have matured for complete data, such algorithms for handling missing values remain limited. We establish general sufficient conditions under which causal graphs remain identifiable (i.e., uniquely determined from the available data distribution) under various missingness categories, including Missing Not At Random, and provide a framework to extend correctness guarantees from causal discovery algorithms for complete data to missing data settings. Our results show that identifiability of causal graphs with no unobserved confounders is preserved when (1) missingness mechanisms do not causally interact, (2) no variable directly causes its own missingness, and (3) either faithfulness holds for missingness mechanisms, or they follow generalized linear models. translated_title: 将因果发现中基于完整数据的可辨识性结果推广至缺失数据场景
translated_abstract: 虽然针对完整数据的因果发现方法已经成熟，但能够处理缺失值的此类算法仍然有限。我们建立了一般性的充分条件，在这些条件下，因果图在各种缺失类别（包括非随机缺失，Missing Not At Random）下仍然是可辨识的（即可以从可用数据分布中唯一确定），并提供了一个框架，用于将完整数据因果发现算法的正确性保证扩展到缺失数据场景。我们的结果表明，当满足以下条件时，无未观测混杂因素的因果图的可辨识性得以保持：(1) 各缺失机制之间不存在因果交互作用；(2) 没有变量直接导致其自身的缺失；(3) 缺失机制满足忠实性条件，或遵循广义线性模型。基于这些理论结果，我们提出了两个针对加性噪声模型的渐近正确算法，用于恢复潜在的因果……
tldr: 该论文建立了在包括非随机缺失在内的多种缺失机制下因果图保持可辨识的一般性充分条件，提供了将完整数据因果发现算法的正确性保证扩展到缺失数据场景的框架，并针对加性噪声模型提出了两个渐近正确的算法。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes general sufficient conditions under which causal graphs remain identifiable under various missingness mechanisms including MNAR, provides a framework to extend correctness guarantees of complete-data causal discovery algorithms to missing data settings, and introduces two asymptotically correct algorithms for Additive Noise Models.
